items.title: JHAI Theme Base
items.description: The JHAI token chain in one stylesheet: the --jh-* brand layer, the shadcn semantic mapping, the v2 vocabulary, and the Tailwind projection. Install this first; every other @jhai item assumes it. Rebrand by overriding --jh-* only.
